blocks.text: The Detroit Pistons and Ausar Thompson have reached an agreement on a five-year, $155 million NBA contract extension, according to a person familiar with the situation. The person spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity Saturday because the deal had not been announced. ESPN first reported the agreement. With a little more than a week left before training camp begins, the Pistons have not re-signed restricted free agent Jalen Duren.
